name.description: Name shown in the session list; default is the file name without .toml.

on_finish.description: What happens after the last stage: stop (default), continue at the last tempo, or repeat from the first stage.

show_muted_visuals.description: Keep animating the pulses during muted stretches. Default false: the screen holds still.

items.description: One stage of the session. With no options it just keeps playing for its length.

bars.description: Stage length in bars; use this or seconds.

mute.description: Play, then mute, over and over. Use the bars pair or the seconds pair, not both.

mute_bars.description: Bars that are muted after each play; goes with play_bars.

mute_seconds.description: Seconds that are muted after each play; goes with play_seconds.

play_bars.description: Bars that play before each mute; goes with mute_bars.

play_seconds.description: Seconds that play before each mute; goes with mute_seconds.

pulse.description: Pulse position, counting from 1; each pulse at most once per stage.

state.description: off: silent and dark; muted: silent but shown; on: always plays.

random_mute.description: Mutes a share of the bars at random.

increase.description: Percent added every every_bars bars (needs every_bars when above 0). Default 0.

max.description: Highest chance the increases reach; at least percent. Default 100.

percent.description: Chance, in percent, that a bar is muted.

seconds.description: Stage length in seconds; use this or bars.

tempo.description: Tempo change in this stage: a one-off jump or set, a ramp, or both.

change.description: Ramp: BPM added each time the interval passes (not 0, negative lowers it). Needs every_bars or every_seconds.

every_bars.description: Ramp interval in bars; not with every_seconds.

every_seconds.description: Ramp interval in seconds; not with every_bars.

jump.description: Add this many BPM when the stage starts (negative lowers it); not with set.

max.description: Ramp ceiling in BPM; only with a positive change.

min.description: Ramp floor in BPM; only with a negative change.

set.description: Set this tempo in BPM when the stage starts; not with jump.

smooth.description: Move in whole-BPM steps on every pulse-1 beat instead of one step per interval; needs change. Default false.
